🧠 Smart Rescue Logic
🪨 Constipation Rescue
"Add 1 tsp cold-pressed oil (rapeseed, coconut, ghee) to today's purée + offer 20ml extra water after solids. This acts as a natural gut lubricant."
💧 Hydration Alert
"Solids going up but water isn't — especially critical in warm climates. 2–3 sips after each solid meal makes a huge difference."
💚 Fibre Bridge
"Stool too loose? Try banana, cooked rice, or plain yoghurt. Hold off high-fibre veg (prunes, peas) for 2 days."

Milestone Tips
⚠️ Safety Always
🚫 Avoid under 12 months: Salt, sugar, honey, whole nuts, raw hard veg, cow's milk as main drink.
🥚 Allergens: Eggs, peanut butter (thinned), dairy, wheat, fish — one at a time from 6 months. Wait 3 days between each.
😮 Gagging vs choking: Gagging is a safety reflex — stay calm. Intervene only if baby is silent and blue/red.
🌡️ Warm climates: As milk reduces, water needs spike significantly. Keep the water log going!
